FAQ.title: What to know before you start a renovation

items.q: Which regulations do you observe for hotel and venue lighting?
items.a: In lighting design we account for both current regulations (emergency lighting, wayfinding, escape-route lighting and energy efficiency) and the light temperature and lumen values that suit the atmosphere of the space. For hotel projects we set distinct scenes for lobby, rooms and F&B areas and integrate them with control systems.

items.q: How do you decide on color selection?
items.a: Color is not only aesthetics — it is psychology. Depending on a space's use we propose palettes that relax, stimulate appetite or sharpen focus; we decide by weighing your brand identity, natural light and material textures together. Every palette is presented for your approval with samples and renders.

items.q: How is the decoration and renovation budget determined?
items.a: We build the budget line by line and transparently during the discovery phase. You see material alternatives (entry, mid and premium tiers), labor and schedule items separately, and we offer a scalable plan based on your priorities. We proceed with a clear, pre-agreed budget — never surprise costs.

items.q: Can you renovate while my business stays open?
items.a: Yes. Especially in hotels and business centers we set up a phased work plan; we move noisy work to low-occupancy hours, protect the guest/staff experience with dust and safety barriers, and keep the operation open as much as possible.
Timelines vary with the scale and scope of the space; however, we commit to a clear schedule at the end of discovery and report progress phase by phase. On-time delivery is central to how we work.
